---
title: "Query a database table"
---

Total the orders and revenue for each region of an SQLite `orders` table,
with phibble's verbs compiled to one SQL query that the database runs. The
script needs the pdo_sqlite extension.

- Verbs only build the query. Nothing runs on the database until the rows
  are needed.
- `showQuery()` shows the SQL with `?` placeholders, and `bindings()` gives
  their values.
- `collect()` runs the query and returns a `DataFrame`.
- The same code runs on PostgreSQL and MySQL.

Runnable scripts: [PHP 8.5+](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstats/phibble/main/docs/examples/database-table.php)
· [PHP 8.3–8.4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstats/phibble/main/docs/examples/database-table-chain.php).
